title: POV: You Wake Up in Great Zimbabwe — The Stone City of Southern Africa #shorts
hook_text: A STONE CITY ROSE WITHOUT MORTAR
description:
Step into Great Zimbabwe, reconstructed as a cinematic historical short using archaeological evidence and cautious interpretation. Some details remain debated or uncertain.

#history #archaeology #lostworlds #ancienthistory #shorts

scenes.text: You approach Great Zimbabwe when its stone enclosures are alive with activity.

scenes.text: Skilled builders stack carefully shaped granite blocks without mortar.

scenes.text: Inside the settlement, homes, workshops, and political spaces spread across the hills and valley.
scenes.image: settlement among granite enclosures and thatched homes, human activity

scenes.text: Gold and ivory connect this inland center to long-distance trade reaching the Indian Ocean.
scenes.image: traders with gold objects, ivory, beads and imported ceramics, restrained

scenes.text: Cattle are important to wealth and daily life, while artisans produce metalwork and pottery.

scenes.text: The Great Enclosure becomes one of the most remarkable stone structures in sub-Saharan Africa.

scenes.text: Over time, political and economic centers shift and the settlement changes.
